dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast, thick white band visible across the mid-wing coverts against a dark gray background.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Moderate prominence of pale margins along the distal boundaries of folded feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A series of rectangular, high-contrast black and white patches forming a barred/checkered footprint on the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Linear and distinct boundary separating the patterned neck/nape from the solid gray mantle plumage.
